meta.title: Linkiva: Everything you are, at one address
meta.description: Gather your links, social accounts and content on one page. What others charge for is free here.

common.genericError: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

landing.headline: Everything you are, at one address.
landing.lede: Gather your links, socials and content on one page. Build it, share it, see who clicks.
landing.freeTitle: What others charge for is free here.
landing.freeLede: No locked features, no trial period.

analytics: Views, unique visitors, click-through rate, sources, countries and devices. No cookies.
themes: Six themes, five typefaces, three button styles, your own colour and background image.
schedule: Make a link go live or disappear at a given time.
highlight: Make your most important link stand out.
capture: Add a subscribe form and download your list as CSV.
embed: YouTube, Spotify and SoundCloud, without slowing the page.
branding: Remove the Linkiva badge with one tap.
qr: Download your address as an SVG or PNG QR code.

landing.closeLede: Claim your username and go live in a minute.
